component.name: PrivacyNotes
component.summary: End-to-end encrypted notes, tasks, and journal

description.p: PrivacyNotes is a zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted place for your notes, tasks, and journal. With self-custody, your 12-word recovery phrase is the only key, so not even we can read your content.
It works offline, syncs across your devices with end-to-end encryption, and keeps your data private by design.
